answer: No, Its not just GNU C Compiler anymore. It supports lot of other programming languages. Originally only for C, later it was  extended to compile C++. Then Front ends were later developed for Objective-C, Objective-C++, Fortran, Java, Ada, and Go among others. So gcc refers to The GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) which is a compiler system supporting various programming languages.
description:
First, We need to Install GNU C-compiler. Lets do it via command

yum -y install gcc

After installation just verify its version.
gcc --version

If you didn't get any error message, then gcc installation went well. :) Btw, Do you know what is gcc?
name: Installing GNU/C Compiler

description:
Lets begin with what we must do ! Yes, Its an unwritten universal rule ! Writing Hello World in C

If you know vim/vi editor open a hello.c and save this content 
int main(){
printf("hello linux world!");
return 0;
}
If you don't know how to use vi/vim editor - just type cat > hello.c

now start typing above program and press ctrl+d to save and quit. Now you have your first C code!. Lets just try to compile with

gcc hello.c
It will create a filename a.out - To run the binary do

./a.out got the output? :D
If you want to create binary with different name just use -o option during compilation, like
gcc hello.c -o hello

Now you will have a binary named 'hello', execute it as
./hello

That's it, You have successfully installed gcc compiler and wrote your first C code then compiled it to create binary and finally executed it!
